ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. A lab fee of $75 will be assessed to cover costs of wine and other course supplies. No textbook is required for this course. Lecture will be conducted via Elluminate course delivery system. Monday lectures are from 6:30 to 7:30 and labs for this section are on Tuesdays from 1 to 3pm. Disregard the assessment notations listed above. The graduate tuition rate for this section is $309 per credit hour; the undergrad tuition rate is $277 per credit hour. All students in this section will also be assessed a $45 per credit hour administration fee and a flat $75 lab fee. These assessments are not included in campus range assessments.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign or Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $309.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $277.00 per Bill Hour, Miscellaneous Fees $75.00 Flat Fee, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
